team.description: meduCA 通过细胞表面展示碳酸酐酶，连接二氧化碳转化与微生物诱导碳酸钙沉淀，形成生物建材。供光、供气和搅拌设计共同构成培养工艺。
team.description_en: meduCA displays carbonic anhydrase on cell surfaces to connect carbon dioxide conversion with microbially induced calcium carbonate precipitation and building materials. Light, gas delivery and mixing form part of the cultivation process.
